title: SDFM
text: Configure filter channel for SDFM Module, 4 outputs, {Filter channel} sets Select filter module; {SDFM module} Indicates which register to use, {Data representation} sets the source of internal, {Sample time} sets the frequency at which data is read and {Enable comparator filter output} sets the enables comparator output ports. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Filter channel
params.values: Select filter module Filter1 (default) | Filter2 | Filter3 | Filter4

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Frequency at which data is read 0.1 (default)

params.name: Enable comparator filter output
params.values: Enables comparator output ports off (default) | on
